material_strengths: Best-evidenced qualification calls in either candidate: S-07 qualified on D-07A–D with the October 2026 expiry read strictly as 'may be reviewed' and the 25-vs-220 licence mismatch disclosed in the draft itself rather than hidden; S-08 disqualified (not nurtured) on the term-scoped procurement freeze; S-03/S-06 disqualified with 'the gap is the prospect's entire supplied market, not an unknown'

S-05 is the strongest single unit: a genuinely non-selling channel enquiry that asks whether a digital-PDF licensing category exists at all, states the offer facts in one line, and invites a one-line 'print only' reply that closes the matter — a real next step matched to the actual dossier

Review.md carries batch-level risks the other candidate lacks: licence-ceiling on every qualified unit, single-jurisdiction concentration with the dated-fact softness, one-shot nurture design, and time-adjacent-but-not-dead disqualified units
Every claim stays inside the dossiers; the unsupported-claims list is enforced and drafts make no results, endorsement, exclusivity or superiority assertions
S-04 handles the free-submission-per-vendor policy tension exactly: recorded as a community-relations option, explicitly not a pipeline action, no draft created
material_defects: Scope and reference integrity: the artifact cross-references files outside the frozen deliverable set — eight sales/units/*.json fragments plus two producer commit IDs and two work IDs — so the delivered artifact does not close on itself; a verifier enforcing the specified change-confinement (only sales/ and verify-sales.mjs) must either fail or specially exempt them

Review.md claims the units were 'imported verbatim' from two producer commits that the reviewer cannot inspect, and the unit files shown contain an assembler-added suggested_priority field absent from the manifest prospects — an evidence claim resting on unavailable provenance

Internal operator/coordination identifiers (work-a94ea56e85, work-cb2f700ea4, commit hashes) leak two-organisation assembly detail into the owner-facing artifact, contradicting its own anonymised-batch framing and adding noise the owner must discount

Assembly explanation is garbled in places: 'S-07-adjacent S-03 takes 7' and 'the operator-suggested priorities are preserved in the unit files' sit awkwardly against the manifest's different order; the rationale for ranking a disqualified S-08 at 5 above nurture-band units is asserted, not argued through

Cold-claim wording is weaker: 'sales-operator-2'-authored units open with 'Your programme page notes… your procurement note records…' as though the centre's internal procurement notes were public website facts
No verifier file is supplied, so the mechanical gate the review points to is unverifiable from the artifact

material_strengths: Tightest citation discipline: every fit claim carries its D-ID, unknowns are kept structurally separate from observed fit in every unit, and the review's counts use correct nested denominators (2 of 3 Sydney organisations qualified; 2 of 2 cohort-sized units over the licence ceiling; 0 of 8 named buyers)

Internally consistent single-batch judgement: S-04 held as nurture with the one permitted free-resource submission framed as an explicit spend-or-hold decision for the lead — a defensible reading of D-04B that avoids both a policy breach and a wasted channel asset, and honest about why no draft exists

Licence-ceiling mismatch is made a first-class batch exception with a correct release gate: settle multi-licence terms above 25 students before either fit-call invitation goes out, since 60 and 220 both exceed one licence

Recommended lead actions are concrete and sequenced (settle scaling, release S-07 then S-01, approve S-02 and S-05, make the S-04 decision explicitly, diary the S-08 term change, record replies against resume conditions so the next batch inherits observations)
No internal identifiers, no phantom files, no unverifiable provenance: every cross-reference inside the artifact resolves, so it works as a self-contained deliverable

Failure awareness is proportionate and quantified: routing risk is structural (0 of 8 named buyers), the S-07 timing hook is treated as timing not dissatisfaction, channel concentration in the nurture band and the thin 2-of-8 qualified band are both named as risks with warnings against over-touching
material_defects: Deterministic schema mismatch: nothing_sent is nested inside the batch object rather than at the manifest top level as the required schema specifies — a verifier checking key placement would flag it, though nothing owner-facing depends on the nesting

S-04 sits awkwardly against the brief's 'prepare a genuinely personalised but unsent next step where warranted' and the locally-closing-unit requirement: nurture with no prepared artifact of any kind, not even the submission outline it says to prepare, leaves the unit less closed than its disposition implies

Sales drafts are thinner and closer to interchangeable: S-01 and S-07 differ mainly by inserted numbers, and S-02/S-05 carry no dossier-specific hook beyond restating the evidence — the personalisation is correct but formulaic where Candidate A's S-05 shows what a channel-matched enquiry looks like

The S-02 sample-only note and S-05 terms enquiry omit the frozen 'preferred first next step' (fit call plus sample) without arguing why the deviation is the better read for a qualified-adjacent nurture unit
No verifier file is supplied, so the mechanical gate the review points to is unverifiable from the artifact

preference_reason: Both deliver the same sound core judgement (S-07 and S-01 qualified, S-02 and S-05 nurtured, S-03/S-06/S-08 disqualified, four drafts held unsent, licence-ceiling disclosed), so the owner's substantive next decision would not change. B is preferred because its artifact closes on itself: every reference resolves, its provenance claims are verifiable from the supplied files, and its review is the more decision-ready surface, while A — despite stronger individual unit prose — leaks assembly identifiers, cites eight unit JSON files and two producer commits outside the frozen deliverable set, and rests an 'imported verbatim' claim on evidence the reviewer cannot inspect; under the scenario's inspect-without-reconstructing standard those are real defects requiring revision, whereas B's defects (nested nothing_sent key, thinner drafts, an unargued S-04 nurture) are minor or cosmetic.
scenario_ambiguities: Whether S-04's nurture disposition — a bounded step that is a held lead decision with no prepared artifact — satisfies 'prepare a genuinely personalised but unsent next step where warranted' and the locally-closing-unit requirement, or whether it must be disqualified or carry a prepared submission outline
Whether nothing_sent must appear at the manifest top level exactly as the required schema states, or whether correct nesting inside batch with the same literal value is tolerable

Whether nurture units may substitute a sample-only note (S-02) or terms enquiry (S-05) for the frozen 'preferred first next step' of a fit-call invitation plus sample, and what argument that substitution requires

Whether verifier output should have been included in the supplied artifact set; neither candidate supplies verify-sales.mjs, so the mechanical gate is asserted rather than demonstrated to the reviewer

Whether batch-level references to prior producer artifacts and commits are in scope for the final deliverable or count as out-of-batch contamination, given the scenario confines all changes to a new sales/ directory and one root file
